description: Read buffered live frames. Omit after_seq to get the most recent frames (a tail snapshot); then pass the returned next_seq on subsequent calls to get only newer frames. Non-blocking.

after_seq.description: Return only frames with seq greater than this (from a prior poll's next_seq).

symbol.description: Filter to a single symbol, e.g. BTCUSD.

name: ws_poll
title: Poll buffered ticks
